global: Valmont gets a broad power cut three weeks after release, with the devs writing that they deliberately overshoot a new hero's strength and overshot his.
Revenant, who the notes call the pinnacle of the carry role, loses trading power, late scaling and the stat steal on his ultimate.
Crucible 3v3 drops its custom damage and durability modifiers entirely — heroes now use their live 5v5 values in the mode.
Weald is trimmed a third straight patch, this time at the Major: missile base damage 8 -> 7 and the on-hit modifier 30% -> 20%.
The defensive minor row comes down together — Immaculate, Dampening and Patina all lose value on the same day.
Shadow's Eve dresses Sanctuary for Halloween: new lighting, jack o' lanterns and candles, with no gameplay change stated.
items: Exodus (crest): Cooldown 90 -> 100; bugfix — its active can now be used while grounded or rooted.
Rift Walkers (crest): Rift Snatcher pull radius 550 -> 625.
Mutilator: Bugfix — now applies on AoE abilities that damage multiple enemies.
Vainglory: Magical armor 35 -> 40; In Vain bonus max stack armors +10% -> +12%.
Crests: Bugfix — automatic basic attacks (Legion, Eden) no longer stack a crest on the first shot only.

eternals.summary: No new Eternals. This is a durability pass: Weald takes its first Major cut after two patches of minor trims, and the blessings that make a hero hard to kill — Immaculate, Dampening, Patina, Lotus's health — all come down together. Krix loses some of the bruiser damage that was making it beat Thraex.

changes.name: Weald
changes.change: Major: missile base damage 8 -> 7, on-hit modifier 30% -> 20%. Taproot bonus physical power scaling 7% -> 6%.
changes.meaning: Third straight trim, and the first to touch the missiles themselves. The on-hit modifier is the bigger half: it was what made the execute scale with an on-hit build rather than just finish low targets.

changes.name: Krix
changes.change: Cannibalism max health on takedown 30 -> 25. Feeding Frenzy attack speed 12% -> 10%.
changes.meaning: Aimed squarely at bruisers picking Krix over Thraex. The notes say there was not enough of a damage trade-off for how much more durable Krix made them.

changes.name: Knell
changes.change: Patina shield 35-290 (+15 per level) -> 30-268 (+14 per level). Dampening damage reduction 12% -> 10%.
changes.meaning: Both of Knell's quiet defensive picks shrink. Dampening only reduces damage from enemies beyond 1100 units, and the notes admit it had been flying under the radar as an anti-poke tool.

changes.name: Lotus
changes.change: Major max health per roll 1.5% -> 1.25%. Immaculate damage reduction 12% -> 10%.
changes.meaning: Lotus keeps its catch-all identity but stops doubling as a tank blessing. Immaculate's third consecutive cut keeps shaving the above-85%-health damage reduction that decides early all-ins.

changes.name: Aion
changes.meaning: A free-gold trim. The notes name Shinbi and Countess as heroes taking it purely to scale, since it pays out without ever interacting with an opponent.
